title: Enhanced magnetoresistance properties of K-site deficient La0.85K0.1□0.05MnO3 manganites synthesized via sol–gel, wet-mixing, and solid-state reaction methods
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38615-38633

The effect of synthesis methods on the structural, magnetic, electrical transport, and magnetoresistance (MR) properties of K-deficient La0.85K0.1□0.05MnO3 (LKdMO) materials has been investigated.
